results.title: [Job 31300] Senior Data Developer, Brazil
results.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.
With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.
We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.
Our client's Digital Supply Chain Analytics team is scaling how artificial intelligence and modern data platforms support day-to-day decisions across manufacturing, logistics, planning, procurement, and operations. The team is running multiple parallel initiatives — from data pipelines feeding AI agents, to a full SaaS replacement for forecasting and inventory management, to machine learning for vision and forecasting systems — and needs additional hands-on developers to keep pace.
The Senior Data Developer joins an existing team and contributes to established code repositories, with work scoped to the individual's strongest skills — whether that's database and pipeline development, application and UI development, or machine learning. Rather than owning a fixed set of responsibilities end to end, this person becomes part of a larger team accountable for the overall project, picking up the pieces of work best suited to their profile. What matters most is the ability to work confidently inside an existing codebase, follow solid Git practices, and communicate clearly and consistently with the rest of the team.

Responsibilities:

Contributes to existing code repositories by extending and maintaining code according to established patterns and conventions.

Follows Git best practices, including branching, commit hygiene, code review, and merge processes.

Communicates progress, blockers, and technical decisions clearly and consistently with the broader team.

Collaborates within a larger cross-functional team accountable for the overall success of each project.

Data Pipelines & Integration

Builds data pipelines that feed downstream applications, including AI agents that manage purchase orders, by integrating and transforming data from sources such as Google BigQuery and SAP.

Develops and maintains ETL/ELT (Extract, Transform, Load / Extract, Load, Transform) processes to ensure reliable, accurate data flow between systems.

Designs and maintains database structures that support operational and analytical workloads.

Application & UI Development

Builds and extends front-end interfaces for internal applications, including a SaaS replacement for forecasting and inventory management.

Develops backend features and administrative functionality that support day-to-day application operations.

Builds and maintains scheduled jobs (cron jobs) that automate recurring application or data processes.

Machine Learning

Supports the development of machine learning models for use cases such as computer vision and forecasting.

Assists in preparing data and features required to train and evaluate models.

Requirements:

Demonstrated experience contributing to and extending existing code repositories in a team environment

Strong working knowledge of Git and collaborative version control practices

Clear, consistent communication skills, comfortable working closely with a distributed team

Depth in at least one of the following areas, with working familiarity in others: database development and SQL, front-end/application development, ETL and data pipeline development, or machine learning

Comfort working across a range of tasks as scoped by the team, rather than a single fixed role

Experience with Google BigQuery, SAP, or similar enterprise data platforms is a plus where relevant to assigned tasks

Nice to Have:

Experience with SAP integrations

Experience building or maintaining SaaS-style applications (forecasting, inventory management, or similar)

Experience with machine learning for computer vision or time-series forecasting

Experience with scheduled/automated jobs (cron) and lightweight administrative tooling

Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, logistics, or procurement contexts

Our benefits:
-Health and dental insurance
-Meal and food allowance
-Childcare assistance
-Extended paternity leave
-Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
-Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);
-Life insurance
-Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);
-Discount club
-Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being
-Pregnancy and responsible parenting course
-Partnerships with online learning platforms
-Language learning platform
And many more!
More details about our benefits here:

results.title: Business Development Representative
results.description:
At Champion , we believe that the biggest growth catalyst doesn’t lie outside, but within. It’s not about more, but about untapping the potential from opportunity that already exists — from within your champions and yourself.
As a product and a company, we’re set on creating deeper partnerships with organizations and their champions so each and every person can do more, together. Our mission is to help organizations activate their happiest customers as advocates — turning advocacy into a true growth engine.
But “ Champion ” isn’t just about business growth. It represents individual and professional growth. We’re building a company where every team member is empowered, celebrated, and supported to become their best.
As an early-stage startup, you’ll be part of the starting lineup — helping build the foundation for Champion ’s GTM success alongside the founding team.
About the Role
Champion is looking for a motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to be the first point of contact with potential new customers. You’ll engage with Customer Marketing Leaders, Chief Marketing Officers, and GTM executives about driving growth through customer advocacy, while working closely with our Account Executives (AEs) and VP of Marketing to develop and execute a coordinated go-to-market motion.
This is more than a traditional BDR role — it’s an opportunity to reimagine how outreach is done. At Champion , we believe the best growth comes from human connection, customer-centricity, empathy, and curiosity. You’ll help pioneer a motion that replaces transactional outreach with meaningful engagement — where every conversation builds trust, not just pipeline.
Your goal is to develop relationships with prospects in our Ideal Customer Profile and convert them into high-quality opportunities through authentic outreach, warm introductions, re-engagement of past conversations, and by driving attendance to Champion ’s in-person and virtual events. You’ll partner closely with our AEs to identify and develop opportunities and with our VP of Marketing to align outreach with campaigns, content, events, and broader marketing initiatives .
We will also invest heavily in your professional growth and Champion YOU!! You’ll be invited to join the Pavilion GTM community to learn from your peers, receive professional coaching, and have direct mentorship from the CEO and COO.
What You’ll Do

Prospect and Engage: Lead outreach to prospective customers through thoughtful, human-centric communication across email, social, and events.

Build Relationships: Develop authentic connections with customer marketing, advocacy, and GTM leaders across mid-market and enterprise accounts.

Create Pipeline: Identify new opportunities through warm introductions, event engagement, and outbound campaigns, aligning closely with our CEO and COO.

Market Intelligence: Research target accounts to identify organizational priorities, customer programs, and advocate signals that align with Champion ’s mission.

Marketing Collaboration: Support campaigns, events, and launches — turning engagement into meaningful conversations.

Process Evolution: Help build and redefine the SDR motion — tools, messaging, metrics, and playbooks. You’ll leave your fingerprint on how we scale and build a human-centric framework for driving growth.
Own Results: Set and achieve measurable goals for outreach, meetings booked, and pipeline created, while ensuring quality stays high.

What You’ll Bring

A self-starter mindset — resourceful, proactive, and driven by results.

Genuine interest in customer marketing, GTM innovation, and AI in B2B.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to connect quickly and authentically.

Deep empathy and human-centric communication — you understand that great selling starts with listening, curiosity, and trust.

Curiosity and confidence to engage executives with purpose and thoughtfulness.

Ability to learn quickly, stay organized, and thrive in a fast-moving environment.

Perseverance: You push through challenges with consistency and optimism, always finding a way forward.

Compensation & Benefits

Base Salary: $65,000–$70,000

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $75,000–$85,000

Equity: Early-stage equity grant

Benefits:

Healthcare, dental, and vision coverage for employees

Monthly equipment stipend for laptop, monitor, and tools

Flexible time off policy

Values We Live By
Go On Offense We’re a culture of experimentation, speed, and adaptation — we play to win.
Be Better Than Yesterday In our arena of growth, every day is a new game.
Get Curious, Not Critical We ask questions before making assumptions, driving deeper learning and greater impact.
Check Your Ego at the Door We collaborate openly, welcome feedback, and celebrate great ideas — no matter where they come from.
One Team, One Goal We believe and understand that we all impact the collective goal.

We are seeking an entrepreneurial International B2B Business Development Manager to drive regional expansion by opening industrial accounts, presenting specialized technical solutions, and converting opportunities into recurring regional revenue.
In this role, you will lead end-to-end commercial growth within your assigned territory—targeting HVAC, industrial equipment, facilities, and mechanical sectors. This position is tailored for a technical sales "hunter" capable of building a durable customer ecosystem from the ground up.

New Revenue Development: Prospect, cold-outreach, and open doors across industrial accounts to generate and convert coating-project opportunities into collected revenue.

Account Ownership & Recurring Sales: Maintain close contact post-sale, follow up on quotes, engage key decision-makers, and drive repeat orders and account expansion.

Ecosystem & Channel Building: Identify, qualify, and recruit regional distributors, resellers, certified-applicator candidates, and strategic partners.

Pipeline & Activity Discipline: Maintain consistent prospecting, meetings, opportunity reporting, forecasting, and routine communication with INFINIGUARD management.

Brand & Channel Protection: Apply approved pricing, claims, commercial terms, and materials to ensure brand value and channel alignment.

B2B Technical Sales Experience: Preferred background in industrial markets, HVAC, mechanical equipment, protective coatings, construction, facility management, energy, OEMs, or technical distribution.

Hunter Mentality: Proven ability to proactively prospect, open new doors, and create opportunities rather than relying on inbound leads.

Relevant Industry Network (Strong Advantage): Established relationships with contractors, OEMs, distributors, engineering firms, facility owners/operators, or industrial buyers.

Language Proficiency: Effective communication in English to coordinate with INFINIGUARD management, combined with strong local-language and cultural fluency.

Equipment & Setup (Mandatory): Must possess your own reliable computer/laptop, high-speed internet, and headset for daily remote operations.

Travel Readiness: Willingness and capability to travel within the assigned market to meet customers, partners, and prospects in person.

High Integrity & Commercial Maturity: Strong ethics, pricing discipline, and a focus on long-term regional development over one-time sales.

results.title: Business Development Specialist
results.description:
Work with the Best
Orderly Network is a combination of an orderbook-based trading infrastructure and a robust liquidity layer offering spot and perpetual futures orderbooks. Unlike traditional platforms, Orderly doesn’t have a front end; instead, it operates at the core of the ecosystem, providing essential services to projects built on top of it.
Our DEX white-label solution is carefully crafted to save builders time and capital while granting access to our bootstrapped liquidity. Picture having the best features of CEXs while keeping settlements on-chain and maintaining full self-custody.
With Orderly, anyone can create a trading application thanks to our seamless plug-and-play experience leveraging our liquidity and composability.
Looking ahead, our grand vision is to create an omnichain protocol, connecting traders from both EVM and non-EVM chains within the same orderbook.
A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network

Orderly's Partnership team accelerates the growth of our ecosystem by identifying, engaging, and supporting builders and partners who build on top of Orderly's infrastructure. In this role, you will be the driving force behind expanding our partner ecosystem — building and managing a robust pipeline of prospective partners, tracking relationship progress through structured CRM workflows, and ensuring partners are activated and growing on Orderly.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who thinks in systems — who can apply internet-era frameworks (funnel management, data-driven tracking, automated workflows) to relationship building and pipeline management at scale.

What will you be working on?
Build and maintain a structured pipeline of prospective partners across multiple verticals (DeFi, gaming, NFT, infrastructure, and beyond), using CRM tools and data-driven tracking systems to manage the full lifecycle from prospect to activation

Apply internet-thinking frameworks to relationship management — treat partner outreach as a funnel: identify → qualify → engage → activate → grow, with clear metrics and tracking at each stage

Develop and execute new growth initiatives to expand the Orderly ecosystem

Collaborate with BD, DevRel, Marketing, and Operations teams to implement ecosystem growth initiatives end-to-end

Engage with builders, investors, exchanges, and infrastructure providers to drive ecosystem growth and partnership activation

Manage grants programs and hackathon participation to attract builders to build on Orderly and encourage composability

Research emerging protocols and verticals; collaborate with L1/L2 ecosystems to drive token utility and cross-chain adoption

Maintain a clean, up-to-date partner database with clear status tracking, next-step actions, and follow-up cadences

Who will you be working with? Maintain close collaboration with Marketing, Operations, Product & BD Teams.

About you

Bilingual fluency in English and Mandarin Chinese — you can switch seamlessly between both languages in business settings (native-level English speaker, e.g., ABC or equivalent bilingual profile, strongly preferred)

Energetic and early-career — you're young, hungry, and eager to prove yourself; we value drive and adaptability over years of tenure

Internet-native mindset — you naturally think in terms of funnels, pipelines, tracking systems, and data-driven relationship management; you're comfortable using CRM tools, spreadsheets, and automation to manage large volumes of relationships without losing personal touch

2+ years of experience in ecosystem growth, BD, partnerships, or portfolio support at a blockchain (L1/L2), venture firm, or internet/tech company — with demonstrated experience onboarding and growing projects from the ground up

You are biased toward action while respecting team-oriented priorities

You are no-ego, adaptable, entrepreneurial, detail-oriented

You are an excellent speaker and writer

You are personable and able to manage expectations across many stakeholders and multiple on-going relationships

Interested in Learning More?

Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues.

If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus.

You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed.

Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well.
